fact: SERNIE held a three-day evaluation workshop on the EDUSER platform on 5-7 May 2026; the article says EDUSER, since its national deployment, centralises learners' permanent numbers and feeds ministry statistics, and asks for five changes (handicap status, parents' occupation, profile deactivation, dashboard filters, classrooms).
title: SERNIE : trois jours d'audit pour renforcer « EDUSER », le cœur numérique de l'école congolaise
